{{Quote|My title, ''Admiral'', is ''Ottdefa'', an honor conferred by my home system, and I would thank you to—&mdash;|[[Osuno Whett/Legends|Osuno Whett]], to [[Klyn Shanga]]|<ref name="Lando Calrissian and the Starcave of ThonBoka">''[[Lando Calrissian and the Starcave of ThonBoka]]''</ref>}}
The '''Lekua system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Centrality/Legends|Centrality]], a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lekua V]].
